description: Lesson i4 mistake: hal-tim-pwm with TIM1 started by CC1E + CEN only (BDTR.MOE never set) - PA0 and PA6 PWM work, PA8 stays silent
expect: 72 MHz; TIM2 CH1 PA0 1 kHz 25 % (250 us high / 750 us low) and TIM3 CH1 PA6 20 kHz 50 % (25 us / 25 us) exactly as in hal-tim-pwm. TIM1 is configured identically to hal-tim-pwm (PSC 71, ARR 499, CCR1 375, PWM mode 1) and its counter runs, but it is started with TIM1->CCER |= CC1E and TIM1->CR1 |= CEN only: BDTR.MOE stays 0, so the advanced timer's outputs stay disabled (RM0008 §14.4.18) and PA8 (AF push-pull) shows no PWM at all; the simulator logs a hint that TIM1 counts with an enabled channel but MOE = 0.

circuit: PA0, PA6, PA8: logic analyzer probes (no load needed)

scenarios.name: TIM1 CH1 on PA8 never toggles without MOE
